_meta.note: Every revert string in the contract maps to exactly one plain-language message for the UI. Keys are the exact on-chain revert strings; nothing here names any person, team, or project.

amount zero.message: The job amount has to be more than zero.

bad sig.message: The signature couldn't be verified. Please sign again.

bad sig length.message: The signature is malformed. Please sign again.

bad v.message: The signature is malformed. Please sign again.

bond shortfall.message: The dispute bond didn't arrive in full. Check your balance and approval, then try again.

cannot cancel in this state.message: This job can't be cancelled anymore — it's already past the point where cancelling is possible.

cannot release zero to worker.message: A split has to pay the worker something — zero isn't a split.

counterparty sig required.message: The other party hasn't approved this settlement. Their signature is required.

deadline not passed.message: The work deadline hasn't passed yet, so the job can't be refunded this way.

deadline passed.message: The work deadline has already passed.

deadline zero.message: The work deadline has to be more than zero.

delivery text too long.message: The delivery description is too long — keep it under 10 KB.

dispute reason too long.message: The dispute reason is too long — keep it under 10 KB.

dust partial rejected.message: That split is too small — partial payments must be at least 1% of the job, or the full amount.

empty delivery hash.message: The delivery is missing its proof. Attach the delivery and try again.

exceeds job amount.message: That amount is more than the job is worth.

funding failed.message: The token transfer failed, so the job wasn't funded. Check the token and your approval, then try again.

job does not exist.message: That job doesn't exist. Check the job number and try again.

malleable sig.message: The signature isn't in the required format. Please sign again.

no agent assigned.message: This job doesn't have a worker yet, so there's nothing to deliver.

no funds received.message: No funds arrived with this job. Check the token and your approval, then try again.

not a party.message: Only the payer or the worker on this job can do that.

not accepted.message: The worker hasn't accepted this job yet.

not agent.message: Only the worker assigned to this job can do that.

not created.message: This job isn't waiting to be accepted anymore.

not delivered.message: There's no delivery to act on yet — the worker hasn't delivered.

not disputed.message: This job isn't in dispute, so that action doesn't apply.

not operator.message: Only the escrow operator can do that.

not payer.message: Only the person who posted this job can do that.

nothing to withdraw.message: There's nothing to withdraw for this token.

only after delivery.message: Disputes can only be raised after the worker delivers.

payer cannot be agent.message: You can't hire yourself for your own job.

reentrant.message: The transaction was blocked while another escrow action was in progress. Try again.

review window ended.message: The review window has closed — it's too late to raise a dispute.

review window not ended.message: The review window is still open. The worker can claim payment once it ends.

review window passed.message: The review window has closed — splits are no longer possible. The worker can claim, or a dispute can settle it.

review window too long.message: The review window is too long for a job this size. Shorten it and try again.

review window too short.message: The review window is too short — it must be at least 1 hour.

ruling period ended.message: The 72-hour ruling period has ended, so this ruling can no longer execute. The refund is the only way out now.

ruling period not ended.message: The 72-hour ruling period is still running. The refund opens once it ends.

settlement signature expired.message: The other party's approval for this settlement has expired. Ask them to sign again.

split signature expired.message: The worker's approval for this split has expired. Ask the worker to sign again.

token must be 6 decimals.message: That token does not use 6 decimals. Only 6-decimal USD stablecoins can be approved.

token not allowed.message: That token isn't accepted. Only approved USD stablecoins can fund jobs.

withdrawal failed.message: The withdrawal didn't go through. Your funds are still safe as a credit — try again later.

worker sig required.message: The worker hasn't approved this split. Their signature is required.

zero address.message: A zero address was supplied where a real address is required.

zero address agent.message: You need to name a worker for this job — the worker address can't be empty.

zero address operator.message: The escrow was deployed without an operator address. This is a setup problem — contact support.
